about: The only departments AVision sends reports to, and the only contact details it may show or put in a drafted report. The AI picks a department from this list (using each one's "handles" line) but never writes contact details; Python takes them from this file. A department is offered to the AI only if it has an email address here, because reports are sent by email. Every entry was copied from the owner's own website on the date shown. Check them again before relying on them, and fix this file (never the code) when one changes.

gsu_facilities.name: GSU Facilities Management Services
gsu_facilities.handles: Buildings and grounds that belong to Georgia State University: classrooms, hallways, doors, elevators, restrooms, lighting, plazas and walkways on campus.
gsu_facilities.phone_note: Main number. After business hours, messages are forwarded to staff.
gsu_facilities.hours: Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 5:15 p.m.

georgia_tech.name: Georgia Tech Infrastructure and Sustainability Customer Service Center
georgia_tech.handles: Buildings and grounds that belong to Georgia Tech (the Georgia Institute of Technology): classrooms, hallways, doors, elevators, restrooms, lighting, plazas and walkways on campus. Not student housing rooms.
georgia_tech.phone_note: Customer Service Center. After hours, urgent problems go to Georgia Tech Police at 404-894-2500.
georgia_tech.hours: Normal working hours, 8 a.m. to 4 p.m.

city_of_atlanta.name: ATL311 (City of Atlanta)
city_of_atlanta.handles: Public streets and sidewalks in the City of Atlanta: curb ramps, crosswalks, potholes, traffic signals, street lights, street signs, trash and anything blocking the public way. Also the choice when no other department clearly fits.
city_of_atlanta.hours: Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to midnight

marta.name: MARTA Customer Service
marta.handles: MARTA property and vehicles: rail stations and their entrances, station elevators and escalators, platforms, trains, buses, bus stops, shelters and benches.
marta.hours: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.

gdot.name: Georgia Department of Transportation (GDOT)
gdot.handles: Interstates and state routes. Not offered to the AI while it has no email address; pick it by hand in the form.
